# Stats Perform

> > Stats Perform delivers Opta-powered sports data, analytics, and AI solutions for football, cricket, ice hockey, and other sports to teams, broadcasters, betting operators, and technology companies worldwide.

Stats Perform is a leading sports technology company providing comprehensive data collection, analytics platforms (including Opta Data Feeds, Opta Graphics, OptaAI Studio, and Opta Live), and performance solutions. The company serves professional sports teams, media organizations, betting operators, and fantasy sports platforms with granular sports data, predictive metrics like xG, player tracking, and AI-powered video analysis tools.

## Key Topics

- Opta
- Sports Data & Analytics
- Opta Graphics
- OptaAI Studio
- Opta Data Feeds
- Opta Live
- Performance Analysis
- Fan Engagement
- Betting & Fantasy Sports
- AI in Sport
- Player Tracking

- Team Performance
- Broadcast Integration
- Predictive Analytics

## Performance Solutions for Teams

- [Opta-powered performance solutions for football](https://www.statsperform.com/team-performance/performance-solutions-for-football): Opta football analytics and predictive analysis solutions for coaches
- [Opta-powered Performance Solutions for Cricket](https://www.statsperform.com/team-performance/performance-solutions-for-cricket): Ball-by-ball Opta cricket data for predictive metrics and player analysis
- [Ice Hockey](https://www.statsperform.com/team-performance/ice-hockey): Ice hockey data and analytics from global leagues and Olympics coverage

## Data Products & Technology Solutions

- [Detailed Sports Data](https://www.statsperform.com/betting-fantasy/trading-tools/granulardata): Granular Opta sports data including F24, XY coordinates, and xG metrics
- [Tech Companies: Visualisations](https://www.statsperform.com/media-and-tech/visual-media): Opta Graphics widgets and sports data visualizations for tech companies
